SELECT r.room_idx AS room_idx, r.title AS title, r.is_group AS is_group, AS last_text, lm.created_at AS last_at, COALESCE(uc.cnt, 0) AS unread_count FROM chat_room r JOIN chat_room_member cm ON cm.room_idx = r.room_idx AND cm.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.msg_txt, m.created_at, m.msg_type, m.file_name FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_idx = r.room_idx AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.message_idx DESC LIMIT 1 ) lm ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chat_message m2 WHERE m2.room_idx = r.room_idx AND m2.sender_id <> #{userId} AND m2.deleted_at IS NULL AND m2.created_at > COALESCE(cm.last_read_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01') ) uc ON true
WHERE cm.hidden_at IS NULL OR (lm.created_at IS NOT NULL AND lm.created_at > cm.hidden_at)
ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.created_at, r.created_at) DESC

SELECT r.room_idx AS room_idx, r.title AS title, r.is_group AS is_group, AS last_text, lm.created_at AS last_at, COALESCE(uc.cnt, 0) AS unread_count FROM chat_room r JOIN chat_room_member cm ON cm.room_idx = r.room_idx AND cm.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.msg_txt, m.created_at, m.msg_type, m.file_name FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_idx = r.room_idx AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.message_idx DESC LIMIT 1 ) lm ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chat_message m2 WHERE m2.room_idx = r.room_idx AND m2.sender_id <> #{userId} AND m2.deleted_at IS NULL AND m2.created_at > COALESCE(cm.last_read_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01') ) uc ON true WHERE r.room_idx = #{roomIdx}

SELECT cm.user_id AS user_id, COALESCE(u.user_name, cm.user_id) AS user_name, d.dept_nm AS dept_nm FROM chat_room_member cm LEFT JOIN user_mst u ON u.user_id = cm.user_id LEFT JOIN dept_mst d ON d.dept_idx = u.dept_idx WHERE cm.room_idx = #{roomIdx} ORDER BY user_name
SELECT FROM chat_message m LEFT JOIN user_mst u ON u.user_id = m.sender_id WHERE m.room_idx = #{roomIdx} ORDER BY m.created_at, m.message_idx
SELECT FROM chat_message m LEFT JOIN user_mst u ON u.user_id = m.sender_id WHERE m.message_idx = #{messageIdx}

SELECT u.user_id AS user_id, u.user_name AS user_name, d.dept_nm AS dept_nm FROM user_mst u LEFT JOIN dept_mst d ON d.dept_idx = u.dept_idx WHERE u.user_id <> #{userId} AND COALESCE(CAST(u.owner_yn AS VARCHAR), 'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY u.user_name

SELECT r.room_idx FROM chat_room r WHERE r.is_group = false AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_member cm WHERE cm.room_idx = r.room_idx) = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_room_member a WHERE a.room_idx = r.room_idx AND a.user_id = #{userId}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_room_member b WHERE b.room_idx = r.room_idx AND b.user_id = #{otherId}) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (title, is_group, created_by, updated_at) VALUES (NULLIF(TRIM(#{title}), ''), COALESCE(#{group}, false), #{createdBy}, now())
INSERT INTO chat_room_member (room_idx, user_id, last_read_at) VALUES (#{roomIdx}, #{userId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (room_idx, user_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO chat_message (room_idx, sender_id, msg_txt, msg_type, file_name, stored_name, content_type, file_size) VALUES (#{roomIdx}, #{senderId}, #{msgTxt}, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{msgType}), ''), 'text'), #{fileName}, #{storedName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET updated_at = now() WHERE room_idx = #{roomIdx}
